title: Sine gatefold
description: Two printed cover flaps unfold around real hinges to reveal a continuous concert-edition artwork.
useCase: Reveal an invitation, printed edition or product insert through its actual folded structure.
reducedMotion: Open and closed states change immediately, preserving the full printed artwork and native controls.
limitations: Authored rigid CSS panels and paper shadows, not a soft-body paper simulation. Sine is an original fictional concert edition; the printed date is demo content.
look: Pale grey surface with a slightly tilted red-orange folded print bearing bold black type and overlapping line ellipses, above a pill-shaped grey button.
motion: Pressing the print or button swings both cover flaps open on their hinges (rotateY ±180° to 0, 720 ms ease-out), revealing the inner spread as creases soften.
adapt: The fold is CSS: `.pf-left` and `.pf-right` rotate on edge `transform-origin` inside a `preserve-3d` `.pf-print`, with `backface-visibility` showing `.pf-cover` or `.pf-inner`; timing is `720ms cubic-bezier(.25,.75,.2,1)`. Replace the `InnerPrint` and `CoverPrint` artwork, split across panels by `offset`.
